activeSeatCount(address).notice: Returns the current number of active seats held by a wallet.

assignSeat(uint32,address,bytes32,bool).notice: Assigns a vacant Senate seat to a holder through the authorized app.

isActiveSeatHolder(address).notice: Returns true when a wallet currently occupies at least one Senate seat.

kernel().notice: Returns the kernel used for narrow registry write authorization.

nominateSuccessor(uint32,address,bytes32.notice: Stores or replaces the nominated successor for an occupied seat.

totalSeats().notice: Returns the fixed v1 Senate seat count.

transferSeat(uint32,address,bytes32).notice: Transfers an occupied Senate seat directly to another eligible holder.

vacateSeat(uint32).notice: Vacates an occupied Senate seat while preserving any nominated successor metadata.
